Plan: 1 to modify.

Summary by type:
  tables: 1 to modify

Tables:
  ~ entries
    ~ entries_sort_idx (index - concurrent rebuild)
    - entries_sort_idx_pgschema_new (index)

DDL to be executed:
--------------------------------------------------

-- Transaction Group #1
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS entries_sort_idx_pgschema_new;

-- Transaction Group #2
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS entries_sort_idx_pgschema_new ON entries (b);

-- Transaction Group #3
-- pgschema:wait
SELECT 
    COALESCE(i.indisvalid, false) as done,
    CASE 
        WHEN p.blocks_total > 0 THEN p.blocks_done * 100 / p.blocks_total
        ELSE 0
    END as progress
FROM pg_class c
JOIN pg_namespace n ON c.relnamespace = n.oid
LEFT JOIN pg_index i ON c.oid = i.indexrelid
LEFT JOIN pg_stat_progress_create_index p ON c.oid = p.index_relid
WHERE c.relname = 'entries_sort_idx_pgschema_new'
  AND n.nspname = 'public';

-- Transaction Group #4
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS entries_sort_idx;

ALTER INDEX entries_sort_idx_pgschema_new RENAME TO entries_sort_idx;
